Truism is rising at this area any many new resorts (and arcades) are in local area. / ===2014=== / The pier is impossible to miss, as it's one of the focal points of this seaside resort. / It was rebuilt on the site of the old pier, in 1994. / The day I went in September the top part of the arcade (Salon Joker, a famous chain in Poland) was open, yet the downstairs with EZ2, DDR and Pump was shut due to off season. I saw the cabinets through the padlocked gate, which was very irritating! / The arcade in general is well maintained and very clean. / There is another makeshift arcade with Tekken, Need for Speed and Virtua Fighter next to a bumper cars setup further inland. The village itself is very nice (in the summer) with a Poland "Hollywood walk of fame" style boulevard and the beach is sandy, clean, and goes out for miles. It's kind of isola...

It offers rooms with free Wi-Fi and a TV, as well as free access to the aqua park and 1 gym ticket. The rooms of the Miejscki Ośrodek feature a classic, elegant interior design and are painted in warm pastel colours. Each one has a seating area, work desk and a spacious private bathroom. While staying at the Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji you can work out at the gym, take a swim in the indoor swimming pool, or play a game of tennis. The spa and wellness centre provides various treatments. The Millenium restaurant specialises in Polish cuisine, in the morning breakfast is served here. Kołobrzeg’s city centre is within 1 km. The city’s main railway station is 1.4 km away. The beach on the Baltic sea is within 2.2 km. Free parking is provided. / Read more: http://www.lonelyplanet.com/poland/kolobrzeg/hotels/miejski-osrodek-sportu-i-rekreacji#ixzz2eZYXTCM8".

Basically pool tables, slot machines, basketball, air hockey and table football into the front room of someones private house. When I went people spoke little English, intimidating at first. Just be friendly and use universal gestures!! Had a nice time there.
